posts.coverText: Your girlfriend has to pick. No “both” allowed 😌

slideText.text: What do you love more about me?
What would you rather have all night?

posts.coverText: The period test 🩸 For your BF

slideText.text: I text: “My period just started unexpectedly at work.”
My cramps are bad but I still have things to get done.
options: “What can I take off your plate?”

slideText.text: I tell you I’m exhausted and don’t feel like myself.
The test isn’t knowing periods exist. It’s knowing YOUR woman. 🩸

posts.coverText: 4 chaotic ahh questions for your boyfriend

slideText.text: If my ex offered me $50K to have dinner with him, are you letting me go?
If your closest friend admitted he’d date me if you weren’t together with me, what happens next?
If we broke up and I started looking better than ever, would that annoy you?
If I could read your mind for one day, what hour would you be most nervous about?
Four questions. Absolutely no peace afterward 😭
